name: Arrogant Superiority
description: When an Aeldari NPO or friendly Aeldari Nemesis shoots or fights a ready enemy operative, and two or more fails are rolled, one of those fails can be discarded to reroll another die.

name: Let the Galaxy Burn
description: Whenever a Chaos NPO or friendly Chaos Nemesis operative is wholly within enemy territory, its weapons gain the Balanced weapon rule.

name: Defenders of the Imperium
description: When an operative is shooting an Imperium NPO or friendly Imperium Nemesis operative, if that Imperium operative is wholly within its territory, one of its defence dice can be retained as a normal success without rolling it (in addition to any cover save).

name: Acquisition at All Costs
description: When a Leagues of Votann NPO or friendly Leagues of Votann Nemesis shoots or fights an enemy that contests an objective marker or victory-determining area, that operative's weapons gain the Balanced weapon rule.

name: Living Metal
description: In the Ready step of each Strategy phase, each Necron NPO and friendly Necron Nemesis operative regains up to D3+1 lost wounds (roll separately for each operative).

name: Waaagh!
description: When an Ork NPO is fighting, its weapons gain Balanced. For Ork Nemesis operatives, worsen the Hit stat of ranged weapons by 1, but their melee weapons gain Severe.

name: Supporting Fire
description: Whenever a T'au Empire NPO is within 3 in of another operative, its ranged weapons gain Accurate 1. Whenever a friendly T'au Empire Nemesis is within 3 in of another friendly T'au Empire operative, that Nemesis operative's ranged weapons also gain Accurate 1.

name: Will of the Hive Mind
description: Ignore stat changes from being injured for Tyranid NPO and friendly Tyranid Nemesis operatives, including weapon stat changes.
